request.recipient: Input Output Global / Intersect administrative treasury governance
request.what: Fund four Hydra workstreams: performance optimization, operational excellence, ecosystem support, and developer experience/maintenance to deliver a feature-complete and hardened Hydra v2.

claims.claim: Hydra is described as the only production-grade Layer 2 on Cardano and as already running live workloads for Delta DeFi, Masumi, Intersect, VTech Labs, Blockfrost, Midgard, and others.
The proposal asks for ₳5,100,781 to fund Hydra v2 hardening across performance, operations, ecosystem support, and developer experience workstreams.
The proposer states that Hydra provides sub-second finality, near-zero or zero internal fees, high parallel throughput, and L1-anchored settlement guarantees.

The proposer claims Cardano L1 has over two hours of finality, approximately $0.17 payment transaction fees, and roughly 7 to 10 TPS, while competitors offer faster finality, lower fees, and higher throughput.
The proposal claims a single Hydra Head processes up to 1,000+ TPS in payment benchmarks and that aggregate throughput scales close to linearly with the number of Heads.
The proposer claims the funded performance workstream will deliver 2x to 10x improvements in snapshot signing and memory profile and reduce L1 fees through on-chain contract optimization.

The proposal asserts that Hydra can retain and attract high-performance builders in DeFi, AI agent commerce, gaming, payments, and verifiable information processing who would otherwise choose Solana or Ethereum L2s.

The proposer states that every Hydra head opening, fund addition/removal, and closure triggers L1 transactions and L1 fees, and that applications with non-zero internal fees can route a portion to the L1 treasury on settlement.

The proposal says the work aligns with treasury KPIs for TVL, monthly active users, monthly transactions, throughput capacity, reliability and uptime, and annual protocol revenue, as well as Pillars 1, 2, 4, and 5.

summary: The document presents a ₳5,100,781 milestone-gated Hydra v2 funding request with claimed production adoption, technical scaling benefits, and ecosystem-growth upside, but much of the key adoption, benchmark, ROI, and budget justification is asserted rather than evidenced in the supplied text.
